## REQUIRED: Fix the failing check, push, and request a new review

1. Read the error output above carefully
2. Fix the code causing the failure
3. Run the failing check locally to verify it passes
4. Commit every change
5. Invoke the /rebase-and-submit skill for PAN-3431 — this is an atomic task. Because verification already ran once (a PR exists), the skill will push your branch and run `pan review request PAN-3431 -m "Fixed test"` for you. NEVER curl `/api/review/...` or any dashboard endpoint — `pan review request` is the only supported re-entry point.

The command can run for several minutes. A yielded exec result or background-terminal notice means it is still running, not that it succeeded. Poll the same terminal until it exits, inspect the real exit code, then confirm `pan show PAN-3431` or `pan review pending` shows the issue re-entered review. Do NOT stop between steps or after pushing; stop only after exit code 0 and the observed pipeline state change.
